title: Hangover-cure Saudi-Arabian Pea-eggplant Wrap
description: Soothe your hangover with our peppery and aerated Saudi-Arabian dish featuring pea-eggplant, carefully wrapped in a gluten-free-friendly ti-leaf wrap.
instructions: Mash garlic and mix with ghee, then set aside.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Add pea-eggplant and cook until it reaches an internal temperature of 185°F (85°C).
Add black pepper, Middle Eastern spices, and salt to the pea-eggplant and mix well.
Warm the gluten-free ti-leaf wraps by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20 seconds.
Assemble the wrap by placing the cooked pea-eggplant mixture onto the center of the warm ti-leaf wrap, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Drizzle Greek yogurt sauce over the pea-eggplant mixture, followed by a sprinkle of parsley, cilantro, and red pepper flakes (if using).
Fold the bottom edge of the ti-leaf wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll up the wrap to create a neat cylinder shape.
Slice the wrap in half and serve immediately.
